assumptions: USD million. Toy confirmed sale is recognized upon documented delivery; documentary letter of credit provides payment security, not cash before bank settlement. Discounting without recourse removes receivable only after accepted documents.

evidence.text: [Export] Goods delivered with signed receipt; invoice 50m, COGS 32m. Confirmed LC covers entire invoice, bank payment due after 60 days.
[Documents] Bank accepts documents on day 10. Exporter sells the accepted LC receivable without recourse to bank for 49m cash on day 12; toy qualifies derecognition.
[Other] Selling expenses 4m, all paid. No taxes or other finance costs. Opening cash 8m.
[Reporting] Separate order 20m has LC opened but goods not delivered; no shipment or customer acceptance.
[Memo] Sales team includes both LC amounts as revenue and describes 70m as cash guaranteed at period start.

qas.question: Doanh thu export đủ điều kiện ghi nhận từ hai đơn?
Lỗ discount accepted LC receivable?
AR còn lại của invoice 50 sau sale without recourse?
Gross profit của hàng thực giao?
PBT sau selling expense và discount loss?
Cash cuối kỳ nếu COGS đã trả tiền cùng kỳ?
qas.answer: 8+49−32−4=21 triệu USD, theo điều kiện bổ sung trong câu hỏi.

qas.question: Vì sao LC opened 20 không phải doanh thu earned?
qas.answer: LC bảo đảm thanh toán khi đáp ứng chứng từ; đơn chưa giao, chưa có performance.

qas.question: Có xác định ngân hàng sẽ chấp nhận chứng từ đơn thứ hai?
qas.answer: Không. Chưa có delivery và bộ chứng từ để xác minh.

assumptions: USD million. Toy sale and repurchase is secured borrowing; securities remain at carrying value. Interest simple, no mark-to-market or other fees.

evidence.text: [Repo] Bank receives 300m cash against bonds carrying 330m; agrees to repurchase in 90 days at 304.5m. Toy retains substantially all risk.
[Funding] Full 90-day term falls within period, principal and interest paid at maturity. No other repo trades.
[Bond] Coupons 6m received during term, all accrued current period. No bond disposal or valuation change.
[Liquidity] Opening free cash 50m, unrelated operating cash flow −20m. No other funding.
[Memo] Trading deck treats 300m as bond sale proceeds and 330m as cost of sales.

qas.question: Debt ghi nhận lúc repo bắt đầu?
Repo interest expense qua 90 ngày?
Annualized simple funding rate theo 360-day basis?
Bond carrying còn ghi nhận sau maturity?
Net interest result từ coupon và repo funding?
Cash cuối kỳ sau repo cycle và dòng khác?
Vì sao không ghi trading loss 30 lúc repo inception?
qas.answer: Khoản cash 300 là borrowing, bonds vẫn được ghi nhận; không sale.

qas.question: Có biết collateral haircut theo market value thực?
qas.answer: Không. Chỉ carrying value 330, không có market value tại repo inception.

assumptions: USD million. Toy investment deposit liability is not premium revenue. Credited interest increases liability, investment income separately earned. No insurance component.

evidence.text: [Deposit contracts] Opening liability 300m. New cash deposits 80m, withdrawals 40m. Credited interest 4% of opening liability, no accrual on new deposits in toy.
[Portfolio] Opening invested assets 320m. Cash investment income 18m, all recognized; no valuation movement.
[Investment flows] New deposits and withdrawal cash routed through investment purchases/sales at carrying value, net purchase 40m. Interest credit not yet paid.
[Expense] Admin expense 3m cash. Opening free cash 10m. No other cash movements, tax or reserves.
[Slide] Sales describes 80m deposits as earned insurance premiums.

qas.question: Interest credited vào deposit liabilities?
Liability investment deposits cuối kỳ?
Portfolio carrying cuối kỳ trước cash investment income?
Net investment spread trước admin?
Profit của hoạt động deposit contracts sau admin?
Free cash cuối kỳ từ deposit, net investments, income, admin?
Vì sao deposit mới 80 không phải insurance revenue?
qas.answer: Tạo nghĩa vụ hoàn trả vốn và lãi; không cung cấp bảo hiểm trong toy.

qas.question: Có đo được duration mismatch giữa assets và liabilities?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu maturity và duration của cả hai phía.

assumptions: USD million. Toy convertible bond bifurcated: initial liability PV 80m, equity residual; proceeds 100m. Liability EIR 8%, coupon 3% face. No fees, tax or conversion during year.

evidence.text: [Issue] Cash proceeds and face 100m. Independent valuation assigns liability component 80m; contractual conversion feature classified as equity under toy.
[Interest] Annual coupon 3m, paid at year end. Effective rate on liability 8%. No principal paid.
[Operations] Operating profit 20m, operating cash surplus 25m; cash capex 40m. Opening cash 15m.
[Policy] Equity component not subsequently remeasured; no other equity change except net profit. No tax.
[Deck] CFO reports debt 100m and coupon expense 3m, ignores split.

qas.question: Equity component tại inception?
Interest expense năm đầu theo EIR?
Debt liability cuối năm theo amortized cost?
Lợi nhuận sau interest không thuế?
Equity tăng trong năm do issue và profit?
Cash cuối năm gồm note proceeds và capex?
Vì sao coupon 3 không phải toàn bộ interest expense?
qas.answer: EIR trên liability chiết khấu bao gồm amortization, tạo expense 6,4.

qas.question: Có tính diluted EPS?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu số shares và điều khoản chuyển đổi.

assumptions: USD million. Toy floating debt balance constant; swap pays fixed, receives benchmark on notional; loan spread separately paid. Cash economics only, no hedge-accounting fair value.

evidence.text: [Loan] Debt principal 200m; annual benchmark 5% plus 2% spread. Entire balance outstanding all year.
[Swap] Notional 150m, pay fixed 4%, receive benchmark 5%, annual settlement. No fee or basis difference.
[Operations] CFADS 35m before interest, no principal due this year. Unrestricted cash 20m initially.
[Stress] Benchmark rises to 7%, spread and swap fixed rate unchanged; no other changes.
[Treasury] Deck labels swap as fixing all 200m debt at 4%.

qas.question: Gross loan interest cash ở base?
Net swap receipt base?
Net economic interest cash base?
Net economic interest stress benchmark 7%?
Effective cash borrowing cost base trên principal?
Cash cuối kỳ base sau CFADS và net interest?
Vì sao swap không fix toàn bộ debt tại 4%?
qas.answer: Notional chỉ 150/200 và spread 2% vẫn trả trên loan.

qas.question: Có tính derivative fair value tại year-end?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu forward curve, kỳ hạn và discount factors.

assumptions: USD million. Toy JV distributes cash first to preferred return 8% on contributed capital, then residual split 70/30 to common A/B. Preferred return noncumulative; no principal redemption.

evidence.text: [Capital] Preferred investor contributes 100m; common A 60m, B 40m. All contributions prior year.
[Waterfall] Annual preferred distribution 8% of contributed 100m, priority over common. Residual 70% A and 30% B irrespective of contribution share.
[Cash] Current distributable cash 30m after operating and financing obligations, all distributed. No additional capital flows.
[Alternative] Stress distributable cash 5m; preferred return not cumulative, common receives nothing if insufficient.
[Memo] Sponsor allocates all distributions pro rata by contributed capital.

qas.question: Preferred distribution base theo 8%?
Cash residual dành cho common ở base?
Common A nhận theo waterfall?
Cash distribution yield của common B trên vốn đã góp?
Preferred investor nhận bao nhiêu trong stress?
qas.answer: 5 triệu USD, toàn bộ cash còn available.

qas.question: Common A distribution stress?
Tại sao không chia 30 theo 100:60:40?
qas.answer: Contract waterfall ưu tiên preferred và quy định residual split khác ownership contributions.

qas.question: Có tính investor IRR chỉ từ distribution hiện tại?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu dated contributions, terminal value và các dòng khác.

assumptions: USD million. Toy unconditional retention AR assigned without recourse; qualifying sale removes receivable. Unbilled conditional rights cannot be assigned under contract. No tax.

evidence.text: [Contract] Gross billed AR 60m including unconditional retention 20m due next year. Separate conditional contract asset 15m.
[Assignment] Bank accepts only retention AR 20m, pays 18.5m cash, no recourse or holdback. Toy derecognition criteria met.
[Collection] Other AR customers pay 25m during period; no new billings or writeoffs.
[Profit] Operating profit 12m before assignment loss; no other finance items.
[Treasury] Draft removes all 35m retention/contract asset, although only 20m accepted.

qas.question: Retention AR sold loss?
Gross billed AR còn sau assignment và customer collections?
Conditional contract asset cuối kỳ?
qas.answer: 15 triệu USD; không nằm trong assignment.

qas.question: Cash từ bank và customer collections?
PBT sau assignment loss?
Discount trên retention face theo %?
Vì sao không loại conditional asset 15?
qas.answer: Chưa chuyển quyền; bank chỉ chấp nhận unconditional AR.

qas.question: Có tính annualized financing cost chính xác của discount?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu ngày maturity chính xác và thời điểm assignment.

assumptions: USD million. Toy callable bond purchased at 104 for face 100, annual coupon 6, issuer calls after two full years at 102. Calculate simple undiscounted and specified PV only.

evidence.text: [Trade] Fund buys face 100m bond for cash 104m at Jan 1 year1. Annual coupon 6m at year-end.
[Call] Issuer exercises option at year2 end and pays 102m redemption plus year2 coupon. No reinvestment or fee.
[Valuation] Carrying at end year1 105m, at just before redemption 103m; toy fair-value P&L separately tracked.
[Comparison] Analyst estimates total gain using redemption 102 minus purchase 104, ignoring coupons.
[No data] No daily NAV series, risk-free benchmark or credit model.

qas.question: Coupon cash tổng trong hai năm?
Tổng cash nhận khi giữ đến call, gồm cả coupons?
Undiscounted holding-period economic gain?
Simple holding-period return trên cost?
Disposal loss tại call so carrying ngay trước redemption?
PV dòng tiền coupon/redemption tại discount 5% giả định trong câu hỏi?
Vì sao call redemption thấp hơn cost không đồng nghĩa economic loss?
qas.answer: Coupons 12 bù chênh redemption −2; tổng cash gain 10.

qas.question: Có tính risk-adjusted performance của fund từ bond này?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu benchmark và portfolio data.
